main_findings: Dependency-guided memory+trace rollback achieved 0.853 controlled recovery with replay ratio 0.123 and 5.70 LLM calls, versus LLM-judge repair 0.773/0.217/9.80 and trace-only AgentTrace-style 0.607/0.091/4.69.
Removing rollback planning reduced recovery to 0.713 and raised calls to 9.19; removing selective replay raised replay ratio to 0.755 and calls to 24.01 without improving recovery.
Independent-support checking primarily preserves benign state and reduces unnecessary recomputation rather than maximizing raw immediate recovery.

The primary paper explicitly presupposes complete-enough runtime provenance and warns that missing edges under-trace contamination while spurious edges over-invalidate; it does not solve provenance uncertainty.
Public LangGraph capture exposes concrete proof-state classes: precise keyed reads, overcaptured whole-state reads, known uncaptured Runnable nodes, and uncaptured conditional-routing reads.
